title: Jailbreak-as-a-Service++: Unveiling Distributed AI-Driven Malicious Information Campaigns Powered by LLM Crowdsourcing
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the generation and detection of AI-driven hate speech campaigns targeting various identity groups, including 'religion', using the Measuring Hate Speech (MHS) corpus. It measured the capability of its 'PoisonSwarm' framework to synthetically generate harmful text targeting these groups and the performance of content moderation detectors (HateBERT) in identifying such AI-generated religious hate speech.
findings: The study found that historical, human-only training data fails to effectively detect the patterns of AI-driven malicious campaigns targeting identity categories, including religion. However, when the detector was trained on a mix of human-written and AI-generated data, its performance in detecting hate speech targeting religious groups (and other dimensions) significantly improved without degrading accuracy on human-generated content.
